ReferralSystem.title: Referral System
ReferralSystem.description: Create your referral code and share it with friends. For each friend who makes a purchase, you get 1% discount (up to 20%).
ReferralSystem.shareDescription: Share this code with friends. When they register and make their first order, you get a discount!
ReferralSystem.step1: Share your referral code with friends
ReferralSystem.step2: Friend registers and uses your code when creating account
ReferralSystem.step3: After friend's first purchase, you get 1% discount on all future orders (up to 20%)
